11:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: First Take
Stephen A. Smith hosts this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment.

12:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Basketball
The Georgia Bulldogs clash with the Cincinnati Bearcats at State Farm Field House in NCAA play. Georgia looks to stay unbeaten after an 88-82 win at Georgia Tech, while 5-1 Cincinnati aims for four straight wins after beating UMass Lowell 78-68.
